**1) Desktop — hero card pill vs. link spacing**

Looking at the green card ("KEUANGAN BULAN INI" / "Rp 0") in image 1, I actually don't see either element you mention — there's no white pill with "Pilih satu hal sederhana..." text, and no "Lihat perjalanan pohonmu →" link rendered in that card. The card only contains the label, the Rp 0 figure, the subtitle, the Pemasukan/Pengeluaran boxes, and the "Buka keuangan →" link.

So strictly speaking there is no touching/overlap — but because the pill and the link don't appear at all, this can't be confirmed as "fixed." If those elements are supposed to exist in the hero card, they appear to be missing entirely (possibly hidden by the fix rather than repositioned). If they're conditional content, then yes, nothing overlaps.

**2) Phone layout (image 2) — issues found**

The mobile layout is mostly well-formed (cards stack cleanly, hero card, stat tiles, Suasana Tamanmu pills all look fine), but there are real problems at the bottom of the screen:

- **Bottom nav overlaps page content.** The "Ritual hari ini" section is cut off by the fixed bottom bar — a list item ("...iasaan K..." text and a row header) is partially hidden beneath it. There appears to be insufficient bottom padding on the scrollable content.
- **The dark "N" avatar circle collides with the bottom nav.** It sits on top of the "…randa" (Beranda) label, obscuring it.
- **The green "Tambah" FAB** overlaps the nav bar and crowds the labels around it — "Beranda" is hidden behind the avatar and the FAB visually crowds "Kebiasaan"/"Keuangan".

**3) Other defects**

- Mobile: the first hero card appears slightly clipped at the top (the "Baca 10 halaman" select is cut mid-card), suggesting the screenshot starts mid-scroll — probably fine, but worth checking if the card header ("SATU LANGKAH HARI INI") is being pushed off-screen rather than scrolled.
- Desktop: no new defects visible — grid, stat cards, ritual list, and progress bars all render cleanly.

**Summary:** Desktop is clean (though the pill/link in question are absent rather than visibly separated). Mobile needs work: add bottom padding so content isn't hidden behind the nav, and reposition the avatar/FAB so they don't cover the "Beranda" label.
